captions.detailed: An adjustable, folding weight bench designed for home gyms. It features a low, black tubular steel frame with a separate seat pad and backrest upholstered in black. At the front, it has a rigid yoke holding two large foam foot-rollers, along with a pair of small transport wheels on a lower axle. The backrest and seat pads pivot on separate transverse hinges to adjust the incline, while the front wheels and foam rollers spin freely on their respective axles.
captions.instruction: Generate a model of an adjustable folding weight bench with a low tubular metal frame, split backrest and seat pads, a rear support link, front transport wheels, and a front foot-roller assembly. Ensure the backrest and seat pads pivot relative to the frame, and the wheels and foam rollers are set up to rotate continuously.
captions.factory: Construct the main base frame using combined box and cylinder primitives for the tubular members. Define separate rigid bodies for the seat pad, backrest pad, rear support link, front wheels, and foam rollers. Create revolute joints for the seat and backrest pivot hinges, and continuous joints for the front transport wheels on their axle and the foam rollers on their shared support rod.
